spans.title: The Armada Chest
spans.blurb: A vendor swears his old box is Armada treasure, kept in his family for generations. The woman examining it reads its true history with her fingertips.

spans.title: The Voyage of the Tubs
spans.blurb: A shipwrecked family sets out for an unknown shore in eight wooden tubs, with hens under planks, a bag of mysteries, and two dogs swimming behind.

spans.title: The Girl on the Hillside
spans.blurb: Boys chase a weeping stranger up a hillside orchard until a young man steps in. She has lived on the island a year, and nobody has ever seen her.

spans.title: The Wrong Suitcase
spans.blurb: In a curtained cafe booth, an overheard quarrel ends in gunfire and sudden darkness. A cowboy flees with a frightened stranger, a suitcase that is not his, and an idea.

spans.title: The Hothouse Bouquet
spans.blurb: Fenella brings her mother a gentleman's hothouse flowers, expecting delight. Instead the household erupts, and the child glimpses truths her mother never meant to show.

spans.title: An English Word
spans.blurb: In a guarded German town, an interned Englishman watches a young mother and her baby on their balcony, and risks a single forbidden sentence in passing.

spans.title: No Tears for Josiah
spans.blurb: A parlor maid finds the master of the house still at his desk in his dinner coat. Upstairs, his widow discovers she cannot feel what she should.

spans.title: The Boarder on Suosso's Lane
spans.blurb: A little old lady in a worn shawl climbs off the bus at a rope works, asking for a job in an accent that is not her own.

books.pairNote: Two separate episodes from one woman's story, a death in a grand house and a later venture among mill workers; neither gives away the other's turn.

spans.title: Pirates of the Sound
spans.blurb: On calm water, a honeymoon canoe draws the notice of a great war canoe with sixteen paddlers. A parley buys minutes; a steady rifle must buy the rest.
spans.spoilerNote: It shows Kate already married to Isaac Pelton, settling the courtship question the romance builds toward.

spans.title: Bab Improves His Mind
spans.blurb: Studying above the library door, a girl overhears schoolmates gleefully mocking someone below, and every teasing word seems aimed straight at her own tender spot.

spans.title: The Voice in the Hedge
spans.blurb: A whisper slips through the garden hedge: the fair is on at Oakfield, there is a real live elephant, and mother need never know.
